questions: Does each bucket correspond to a specific well, or can a bucket be used across different wells? The prompt says 'each well has a corresponding bucket', but the reference solution sums per well, implying buckets are well-specific.

Is the bucket lowered once per well per trip, or once per bucketful across all wells? The prompt says 'number of times you need to lower the buckets' but the reference solution sums per well, implying each well's bucket is lowered independently.
Can a bucket be partially filled? The reference solution uses ceil(sum/capacity), implying buckets must be filled to capacity except possibly the last trip per well.
If a well has zero water, does it require zero operations? The clarification says 'Zero operations, since there's no water to remove', but it's unclear if that's for the entire grid or per well.
Are buckets reusable across trips? The reference solution implies each trip uses a bucket (lowered once per trip), but it's not explicitly stated.
Does lowering a bucket count as an operation even if it comes up empty? The reference solution uses ceil, so empty wells contribute zero.
Is the grid guaranteed to be rectangular? The constraints say 'all wells have the same length', but the prompt doesn't explicitly state it.
What if capacity is zero? The constraints say 1 <= capacity, so it's not allowed.
